display.purpose: Headings, page titles, section headings, and interactive buttons only.

label.purpose: Metadata, breadcrumbs, field labels, timestamps, ratings, locale toggles.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Border and background color transitions on interactive chrome.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The system's single confident action — a VU Gold slab with ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #e8b84b; color: #14120f; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f2c866; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8b84b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet surfaced action — Vinyl Surface fill with a hairline Groove Border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #1f1b17; color: #f2ede4; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #2e2a24; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #e8b84b; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8b84b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Link / Button
components.description: Invisible-level action; Aged Linen text that warms to Paper on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; color: #a89e8e; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 8px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #f2ede4; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8b84b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A surfaced field on the ink ground, with a Groove hairline that turns gold on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; color: #a89e8e; } .ds-input { background: #1f1b17; color: #f2ede4; font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #2e2a24; border-radius: 6px; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a89e8e; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid #e8b84b; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #2e2a24; }

components.name: Album Card
components.description: A content surface for a physical collection object — a square sleeve with a Groove hairline that warms to gold.
components.html: The WallStudio
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; background: #1f1b17; border: 1px solid #2e2a24; border-radius: 10px; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #e8b84b; } .ds-cover { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2e2a24 0%, #1f1b17 60%); } .ds-meta { min-width: 0; } .ds-title { display: block; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #f2ede4; } .ds-cat { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #a89e8e; }

components.name: Breadcrumb / Data Nav
components.description: The typographic division of labor in action: breadcrumb trails set in IBM Plex Mono, aged linen to paper on hover.
components.css: .ds-breadcrumb ol { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px; list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #a89e8e; } .ds-breadcrumb a { color: #a89e8e; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-breadcrumb a:hover { color: #f2ede4; } .ds-breadcrumb [aria-current='page'] { color: #f2ede4; } .ds-breadcrumb li + li::before { content: '/'; margin: 0 4px; color: #a89e8e; }

narrative.overview: Warm, quiet, deliberate, tactile. The interface treats music as a material culture — something held, studied, and discussed with care. The entire system is a darkened listening room: an ink-warm near-black as the walls, paper-warm text as lamplight, and the amber glow of a VU meter as the single accent that draws the eye when a decision or interaction asks for attention. There is no noise here, no decorative motion, no gratuitous gradient — every element earns its place by helping you read, rate, and discuss a discography with the precision a serious listener expects. Two layers of material character coexist deliberately. The interactive chrome — buttons, inputs, navigation — stays quiet, refined, and minimally visible; it is furniture, not decoration. The content surfaces — album cards, cover art, the disc placeholder, list entries — carry the tactile, object-like quality of the physical collection: a vinyl sleeve held up to the light.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-dark material environment; never pure black, never pure white — always earth-tinted paper and ink
A single, disciplined amber accent used sparingly across the whole screen (focus rings, primary actions, active states)
Flat, tonal depth system: surfaces layer by temperature, never by shadow
Editorial typography triad: a grotesque for display, a serif for reading, a monospace for data
Interaction furniture is quiet; content surfaces carry the object-like tactility of the physical collection
Respects prefers-reduced-motion; visible focus outline always on

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: VU Gold appears on ≤10% of any given screen. Its power comes from being the only thing that glows in the dark. When everything is amber, nothing is.

rules.name: The No-Black Rule
rules.body: Never use pure #000, pure #fff, or the default Tailwind palette. Every color here is earth-tinted; the warmth is the identity.

rules.name: The Typographic Division of Labor Rule
rules.body: Display speaks, body reads, mono measures. Headings and buttons are always Space Grotesk; paragraphs and comments are always Source Serif; any data — dates, ratings, member roles, breadcrumbs, field labels, locale toggles — is always IBM Plex Mono. Do not swap these roles for flourish.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Elevation is never a box-shadow. If you need to separate a surface, step it one temperature lighter (ink-surface) and draw a ink-border hairline around it — never cast a drop shadow.

dos: Do keep the amber accent rare and disciplined — it is the one light in the room.
Do express depth by stepping background temperature (ink → Vinyl Surface) and drawing Groove Line hairlines, never with box-shadows.
Do honor the typographic division of labor: Space Grotesk for display, Source Serif for body, IBM Plex Mono for data and labels.
Do keep cover art square and surfaces gently curved (4–10px), never pill-shaped.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion and always keep the 2px amber focus outline visible.
donts: Don't use pure #000, pure #fff, or the default Tailwind palette — warmth is the identity.
Don't add decorative shadows, gradients, or motion that competes with content.
Don't render audio imagery as empty rectangles — use the disc/record silhouette when art is missing.
Don't let any secondary color (teal, danger) shout louder than VU Gold; it owns visual emphasis.
Don't introduce pill-shaped or fully sharp corners; stay in the 4–10px radius language.
